prompt: Inside a Rudder Codex run, improve an existing multi-file skill and prove the revision is better than the old version. Design a two-prompt old_skill versus with_skill evaluation, including metadata, assertions, timing, grading, benchmark aggregation, analyst review, and a static human review viewer. Explain where the workspace belongs when project context exists and what locations must not be used. Do not run the evaluation; return a decision-complete procedure.
assertions: Uses $RUDDER_PROJECT_LIBRARY_ROOT/skill-evals for the durable evaluation workspace
Defines paired with_skill and old_skill runs with metadata, assertions, timing, and grading
Aggregates benchmark artifacts, performs an analyst pass, and generates a static review with generate_review.py
Rejects the bundled package and provider-managed runtime mount as evaluation output locations
